- The C3 standard deductible is €50 (<cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="1" name="contract.pdf"/> Art. 2). The settlement is €320 − €50 = €270, as calculated by the system.
- The system found no missing documents and no possible exclusion. Its checks did not flag any blocking issue.
- The system also treated the claim as reported on time. I could not verify the reporting deadline, because the contract file I could read stops after Article 2.
- The system returned no assessor requirement.

**Amounts (from compute_settlement)**

- Deductible: €50
- Payout: €270
- Assessor required: No

The subagent's reasoning cites a 5-day reporting limit and Article 6.2. I could not confirm either from the contract text, so please verify them against the full contract.

- The photos and quote were not opened, so their contents have not been checked.
